networks.title: Residual MLP
networks.description: The reference diagram: a down projection, three gated residual branches and a gated head, every layer drawn out.

networks.title: Residual MLP with a block
networks.description: The same network with the gated branch defined once as GatedBlock and repeated 3 times.

networks.title: MLP, 10 layers, ReLU
networks.description: A plain deep MLP: 10 Linear layers with ReLU between them. Good for seeing how depth and init affect the signal.

networks.title: MLP, 10 layers, Tanh
networks.description: The same 10-layer MLP with Tanh between the layers.

networks.title: Pre-norm residual MLP
networks.description: A transformer-style stack: four pre-LayerNorm GELU MLP blocks with residual connections, then a classifier.

networks.title: Decoder-only transformer, fully expanded
networks.description: A 2-layer GPT-style decoder with every layer drawn out: token and position embeddings, causal multi-head self-attention, a GELU MLP, residuals, LayerNorms and the LM head.

networks.title: GPT-2 (124M architecture)
networks.description: GPT-2 small: token and position embeddings, 12 × GPT2Block (pre-norm causal self-attention and a tanh-GELU MLP, with dropout), a final LayerNorm and the LM head. GPT-2 initialization: N(0, 0.02), residual projections scaled by 1/√24. The LM head shares its weights with the token embedding (weight tying), as in GPT-2: 124,439,808 parameters.

networks.title: BERT-base (masked LM)
networks.description: BERT-base as BertForMaskedLM: word, position and token-type embeddings with a LayerNorm, 12 × BertLayer (post-norm: bidirectional self-attention, then a GELU feed-forward, each followed by add & LayerNorm), and the masked-LM head whose decoder shares its weights with the word embedding. 109,514,298 parameters, BERT initialization N(0, 0.02).

networks.title: Llama 2 7B
networks.description: Llama 2 7B as LlamaForCausalLM: token embedding, 32 × LlamaDecoderLayer (pre-norm with RMSNorm; causal self-attention with rotary position embeddings on q and k; a SwiGLU MLP, down(silu(gate(x)) · up(x))), a final RMSNorm and an untied LM head. No biases. 6,738,415,616 parameters, initialization N(0, 0.02). The code builds the full model, about 27 GB in float32.

networks.title: Qwen2.5-VL 3B
networks.description: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct as Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, giving the same output as the reference implementation in Hugging Face transformers. Inputs as Qwen's processor gives them: pixel_values (every image's 14 × 14 × 2-frame patches, 1176 values each, one list for all images), image_grid_thw (frames, rows, columns of patches per image) and input_ids (with image placeholder tokens). Vision: patch embedding, patches put in window order, 4 × Qwen2_5_VLVisionStage (32 blocks: 2D rotary positions, attention within 112-pixel windows except every eighth block, which attends over the whole frame), patch merger, original order restored. The image features replace the placeholder tokens; 36 × Qwen2_5_VLDecoderLayer with M-RoPE 3-D positions; final RMSNorm and an LM head tied to the embedding. 3,754,622,976 parameters.

networks.title: Basic CNN (MNIST)
networks.description: A plain convolutional classifier for 28 × 28 digits, no blocks: two Conv 3×3 → ReLU → max pool stages (32 and 64 channels), then flatten, Linear 3136 → 128 → ReLU → dropout → Linear 128 → 10, trained with cross-entropy.

networks.title: ResNet-50 (ImageNet)
networks.description: ResNet-50 as in torchvision (v1.5, stride on the 3×3): a 7×7 stem and max pool, then four stages of bottleneck blocks (3, 4, 6, 3) at 256 / 512 / 1024 / 2048 channels, global average pooling and a 1000-way Linear. 25.6M parameters; the same layers, in the same order, as torchvision.models.resnet50.

networks.title: YOLOv3 (416, COCO)
networks.description: YOLOv3 as in Darknet's yolov3.cfg: the Darknet-53 backbone (Conv-BN-LeakyReLU layers and 1 + 2 + 8 + 8 + 4 residual blocks), then detection at three scales: 13 × 13 for large objects, and 26 × 26 and 52 × 52 after upsampling and joining the backbone's features. Each output has 255 = 3 boxes × (4 coordinates + objectness + 80 classes) channels per cell. 61.9M parameters.

networks.title: RNN (Elman)
networks.description: A basic recurrent network drawn flat: h = tanh(W_ih·x + W_hh·h_prev), where h_prev comes from a Delay (the previous time step, zeros at the start). The code runs it as a loop over time. Same parameters and outputs as nn.RNN(16, 64) with tanh; a Linear reads 8 values out of every step, trained by mean squared error against a target sequence.

networks.title: LSTM
networks.description: A long short-term memory network drawn flat: four gates (input i, forget f, cell g, output o), each from x and from h_prev; then c = f ⊙ c_prev + i ⊙ g and h = o ⊙ tanh(c). Delays carry h and c to the next step. Same parameters and outputs as nn.LSTM(16, 64) (its weight_ih is the four gates' ih weights stacked); a Linear reads 8 values out of every step, trained by mean squared error against a target sequence.

networks.title: GRU
networks.description: A gated recurrent unit drawn flat: reset r and update z gates from x and h_prev, the candidate n = tanh(W_in·x + r ⊙ (W_hn·h_prev)), then h = (1 − z) ⊙ n + z ⊙ h_prev, with a Delay carrying h to the next step. Same parameters and outputs as nn.GRU(16, 64); a Linear reads 8 values out of every step, trained by mean squared error against a target sequence.

networks.title: ViT-B/16 (ImageNet)
networks.description: The Vision Transformer, as torchvision's vit_b_16: the 224 × 224 image is cut into 16 × 16 patches by a strided convolution (196 patches of 768 features), a learned class token goes in front, learned position embeddings are added, then 12 pre-norm encoder blocks (12-head self-attention and a GELU MLP of width 3072), a final LayerNorm, and a 1000-way Linear on the class token. 86.6M parameters, the same as torchvision.

networks.title: Mamba-130M
networks.description: Mamba (state-spaces/mamba-130m, as transformers' MambaForCausalLM): token embeddings, 24 MambaBlocks (RMSNorm, then the selective state space mixer: input projections, a causal depthwise convolution, input-dependent Δ, B and C, and the scan h = exp(Δ·A) ⊙ h_prev + Δ·B·u drawn flat with a Delay, read out by C, plus D·u, gated by SiLU(z)), a final RMSNorm and an LM head tied to the embeddings, trained on the next token. 129M parameters, the same as the reference.

networks.title: VAE (MNIST)
networks.description: A variational autoencoder, as in PyTorch's examples/vae: the encoder (784 → 400, ReLU) gives the mean μ and log-variance of a 20-dimensional Gaussian; z = μ + ε·exp(½·logvar) with ε from a Noise node (the reparameterization trick, so gradients reach μ and σ); the decoder (20 → 400 → 784) gives pixel logits. The loss is the negative evidence lower bound: binary cross-entropy summed over the pixels (784 × the mean) plus the KL divergence of the latent Gaussian from N(0, 1). predict() applies the sigmoid. 652,824 parameters.

networks.title: U-Net (segmentation)
networks.description: U-Net as in milesial/Pytorch-UNet (bilinear=False): an encoder of DoubleConv and four Down steps (64 → 1024 channels, 256 → 16 pixels), a decoder of four Up steps that double the size with a transposed convolution and join the encoder's map at the same size (the skip connections), and a 1×1 convolution to a score per class per pixel. Trained with per-pixel cross-entropy against a mask of class indices. 31,037,698 parameters, the same as the reference.

networks.title: Transformer (encoder-decoder)
networks.description: The original Transformer, "Attention Is All You Need" (base: d = 512, 8 heads, feed-forward 2048, 6 + 6 layers, dropout 0.1), computed as nn.Transformer does (post-norm, with a final LayerNorm on the encoder and the decoder). Source and target tokens share one embedding (37,000 BPE tokens), scaled by √d, plus fixed sinusoidal positions; the encoder's output (memory) goes to the cross-attention of every decoder layer; the output projection shares the embedding's weights. Trained on the next target token with label smoothing 0.1. 63,084,544 parameters.

networks.title: I-JEPA (small)
networks.description: A small I-JEPA (facebookresearch/ijepa: ViT encoder and predictor; 32 × 32 images, 4 × 4 patches, width 192, 6 + 3 layers). The context encoder sees only the context patches (ctx_idx); the predictor, given their embeddings plus a mask token at each target position (tgt_idx), predicts the target patches' embeddings; the target encoder sees the whole image and gives the embeddings to predict. It follows the context encoder (an EMA tie: a copy that gets no gradients, moved toward it after each step, momentum 0.996 → 1.0), as does its patch embedding. Fixed 2-D sine/cosine positions (frozen); smooth L1 loss. train.py draws I-JEPA's block masks for every batch.

networks.title: Residual CNN, global average pooling head
networks.description: The CNN from the inductive-bias lecture: a 5×5 conv stem, then three pre-norm residual blocks (GroupNorm → ReLU → 3×3 conv, twice, plus a clean identity skip) with 2×2 max pooling, a final GroupNorm and ReLU, then global average pooling (adaptive average pool to 1 × 1) and one Linear. Position is averaged away before the classifier. 57,098 parameters.

networks.title: Residual CNN, dense head
networks.description: The same residual CNN, but the 32 × 7 × 7 feature maps are flattened into one Linear. Every position gets its own classifier weights, so the dense head brings back the addresses convolution removed. 72,458 parameters.

blocks.title: BertLayer
blocks.description: BERT encoder layer (post-norm): bidirectional multi-head self-attention, then a GELU feed-forward, each followed by add & LayerNorm.

blocks.title: DarknetConv
blocks.description: Darknet's convolutional layer: Conv k×k with padding k // 2 and no bias, BatchNorm, LeakyReLU(0.1).

blocks.title: DarknetResidual
blocks.description: Darknet-53 residual block: a 1×1 DarknetConv to half the channels, a 3×3 back to the channels, plus the input.

blocks.title: GatedBlock
blocks.description: Pre-norm gated residual branch: x + (σ(N W) ⊙ N W ⊙ N V) W_out, with N = RMSNorm(x).

blocks.title: GPT2Block
blocks.description: GPT-2 transformer block: pre-LayerNorm causal multi-head self-attention and a tanh-GELU MLP, each with dropout and a residual.

blocks.title: JEPABlock
blocks.description: I-JEPA's Vision Transformer block (as timm's): pre-norm multi-head self-attention and a GELU MLP (4× width), each with a residual add; LayerNorm eps 1e-6; weights N(0, 0.02), zero biases.

blocks.title: Encoder
blocks.description: An I-JEPA encoder's transformer: JEPABlock × 6 and a final LayerNorm (eps 1e-6), on a sequence of patch embeddings.

blocks.title: LinearReLU
blocks.description: A Linear layer followed by ReLU; repeat it to make a deep MLP.

blocks.title: LlamaDecoderLayer
blocks.description: Llama decoder layer: pre-RMSNorm causal self-attention with rotary position embeddings on q and k, then a SwiGLU MLP, each with a residual. No biases.

blocks.title: MambaBlock
blocks.description: Mamba residual block (transformers' MambaBlock with MambaMixer): RMSNorm; in_proj split into in_x and in_z; causal depthwise Conv1d and SiLU on x (u); x_proj split into Δ (low rank, then dt_proj and softplus), B and C; the selective scan h_t = exp(Δ_t·A) ⊙ h_{t−1} + Δ_t·B_t·u_t with A = −exp(A_log), drawn flat with a Delay; y = Σ_n h·C + D·u; gated by SiLU(z); out_proj; residual.

blocks.title: PreNormConvBlock
blocks.description: A pre-norm residual block for images: GroupNorm → ReLU → 3×3 conv, twice, plus a clean identity skip (x + h). The channel count and image size stay the same.

blocks.title: PreNormMLP
blocks.description: Transformer-style MLP with a residual: x + W2 GELU(W1 LayerNorm(x)).

blocks.title: Qwen2_5_VLDecoderLayer
blocks.description: Qwen2.5 decoder layer: pre-RMSNorm causal self-attention with M-RoPE positions (time, row, column; sections 16/24/24, base 1e6) where 16 query heads share 2 key/value heads (bias on q, k, v), then a SwiGLU MLP, each with a residual. Inputs: hidden states and the 3-D positions.

blocks.title: Qwen2_5_VLPatchMerger
blocks.description: Qwen2.5-VL patch merger: RMSNorm, then each 2 × 2 group of patches side by side, Linear → GELU → Linear to the language model width.

blocks.title: Qwen2_5_VLVisionBlock
blocks.description: Qwen2.5-VL vision encoder block: pre-RMSNorm multi-head self-attention (bias on the projections; 2D rotary positions from each patch's row and column; attention limited by the mask input) and a SwiGLU MLP with bias, each with a residual. Inputs: patches, the allowed-attention mask, patch positions.

blocks.title: Qwen2_5_VLVisionStage
blocks.description: Eight Qwen2.5-VL vision blocks: seven attending within 112-pixel windows (window_mask), then one attending over each whole frame (frame_mask). Four of these make the 32-block vision encoder.

blocks.title: Bottleneck
blocks.description: ResNet bottleneck block: 1×1 convolution down to the width, 3×3, 1×1 back up to the channels, each followed by BatchNorm (ReLU between), plus the identity shortcut and a final ReLU.

blocks.title: BottleneckDown
blocks.description: The first ResNet bottleneck block of a stage: like Bottleneck, but it changes the channels (and halves the size with stride 2, on the 3×3), so its shortcut is a 1×1 convolution with the same stride and a BatchNorm.

blocks.title: SwiGLU
blocks.description: Gated MLP without a residual: W_out (SiLU(x W) ⊙ x V). Output size can differ from input size.

blocks.title: DecoderLayer
blocks.description: A Transformer decoder layer (post-norm, as nn.TransformerDecoderLayer): causal self-attention; cross-attention, with queries from the decoder and keys and values from the encoder's output (memory, the second input); the feed-forward network. Each followed by dropout, a residual add and a LayerNorm.

blocks.title: EncoderLayer
blocks.description: A Transformer encoder layer (post-norm, as nn.TransformerEncoderLayer): multi-head self-attention, dropout, residual add, LayerNorm; then Linear → ReLU → dropout → Linear, dropout, residual add, LayerNorm.

blocks.title: DoubleConv
blocks.description: U-Net's double convolution: (Conv 3×3 with padding 1, no bias → BatchNorm → ReLU) twice.

blocks.title: Down
blocks.description: A U-Net step down: max pool 2 (half the size), then DoubleConv.

blocks.title: Up
blocks.description: A U-Net step up: ConvTranspose 2×2 with stride 2 on the deeper map (twice the size, c_out channels), joined along the channels with the skip connection from the way down (x2 first), then DoubleConv.

blocks.title: ViTEncoderBlock
blocks.description: Vision Transformer encoder block (torchvision's EncoderBlock): LayerNorm, multi-head self-attention without a mask, residual; LayerNorm, Linear → GELU → Linear, residual. LayerNorm eps 1e-6.

blocks.title: YoloConvSet
blocks.description: The five convolutions before each YOLOv3 detection: 1×1 to c, 3×3 to 2c, 1×1, 3×3, 1×1.

blocks.title: YoloDetect
blocks.description: A YOLOv3 detection head: a 3×3 DarknetConv to twice the channels, then a 1×1 convolution with bias to n_out = 3 × (5 + classes) values per cell.
